purpose: Minimal Q43-semantic sample used by R0 reproduction to show the original gate accepts evidence bound only to the mutable working tree (no immutable Git-object pin).

action_risk_class.definition: The graded classification of an action's potential harm if it goes wrong (e.g. REPOSITORY_LOCAL_REVERSIBLE vs HIGH_RISK_EXTERNAL).
action_risk_class.claim: each action receives exactly one bounded risk class

reversibility.definition: Whether an action can be undone without external side effects. Reversible actions may be automatic repository-local; irreversible ones require confirmation/escalation.

authority.definition: The bounded authority level under which an action may be taken (repository candidate, expert, institutional). Authority is never self-upgraded.

escalation.definition: The path an action takes when it exceeds the candidate's bounded authority: request-only to a human expert or institution.

escalation_contrast.note: A high-risk EXTERNAL action is never performed by the repository candidate; it is converted into a request-only escalation to a human with the required authority.

non_claims: no legal action is performed by this candidate
no medical action is performed by this candidate
no financial action is performed by this candidate
no safety-critical external action is performed by this candidate
this candidate does not establish a universal truth
this candidate does not establish a causal proof
this candidate is not deployed to an ecosystem
